chunks: And because they practised usury although it had been forbidden them; and for using others' wealth unjustly. For those who are unbelievers among them We have reserved a painful punishment.
ai.seo_question: What are the two main economic sins mentioned in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah An-Nisa underscores the severity of riba and unjust wealth consumption as distinct markers of the disbelievers, linking economic injustice directly to spiritual deviation. In Shia exegesis, these practices are often viewed as systemic corruptions that undermine social equity, serving as a precursor to the divine punishment detailed in the subsequent verses.
